description: Percent-encode text (encodeURIComponent or encodeURI semantics), identical to the Toolars url-encoder-decoder web tool. Runs entirely locally; no network or filesystem access. Input and result enter the MCP client context and may be sent to its model provider.

mode.description: component encodes every reserved character (encodeURIComponent); uri leaves URI structure characters (encodeURI).

text.description: UTF-8 text to process. Nothing is read from files or URLs.

name: toolars_url_encode
